lineage.description: Population projections for 2021 were generated by the Central Statistical Organization Iraq using demographic projection methodology. Data are disaggregated by sex and 5-year age groups at national (ADM0) and subnational (ADM1) administrative levels, suitable for spatial joins to administrative boundary datasets for disaster risk assessment.
